parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language in which the response is displayed. Values: zh (default): Chinese, en: English

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: Resource ID, which is the ID of the registration and configuration center instance or the unique ID of the gateway

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: Resource type, such as a registration and configuration center cluster or gateway instance

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse change-resource-group --resource-type Cluster,Gateway --resource-id 'mse-cn-xxxxxxxxxxx，_gw-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' --resource-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfm34x43l00000 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
